editor_note: The meaning is faithful throughout. The limit behaviour in [7]-[12] (active workloads keep running, pending jobs stay queued, the Flex vs Premium conditions) and the allocation-vs-usage-limit explanation in [14] both match the English. There are three small editorial issues. In [5] and [16] the sentence-final period was moved inside the link text ("[página de instâncias.]", "[instâncias.]", "[escalonador de compartilhamento justo.]"). In [16], "minimize job usage" became "minimizar o tempo quântico de jobs", which adds "tempo quântico" (not wrong in context). In [4], "os QPUs" uses the masculine, while Brazilian technical usage normally treats QPU as feminine ("as QPUs", from "unidade de processamento quântico").

examples.source: on the [instances page](https://quantum.cloud.ibm.com/instances).
examples.translation: na [página de instâncias.](https://quantum.cloud.ibm.com/instances)
examples.suggested: na [página de instâncias](https://quantum.cloud.ibm.com/instances).
examples.why: The sentence period was moved inside the link label. The same thing happens in all three bullets of [16].

examples.source: Review suggestions to [minimize job usage](minimize-time).
examples.translation: Veja sugestões para [minimizar o tempo quântico de jobs.](minimize-time)
examples.suggested: Veja sugestões para [minimizar o uso de jobs](minimize-time).
examples.why: Adds 'tempo quântico', which is not in the source. It is harmless given the target page, but it is not a literal rendering.

examples.source: based on usage of all QPUs
examples.translation: com base no uso de todos os QPUs
examples.suggested: com base no uso de todas as QPUs
examples.why: QPU (unidade de processamento quântico) is normally feminine in Portuguese technical writing.

editor_note: The translation is faithful and reads naturally. "Authorization roles" becomes "Funções de autorização", which matches IBM Cloud's own PT-BR wording, and every table row keeps the right verb and object, as in "Cancelar um job", "Obter configuração das lanes do backend" and "Fechar sessão do job". Job and backend stay in English throughout, used the same way each time.

The translation is faithful throughout. There is no semantic drift, and terms are used consistently (API C, passes de transpilador, medição projetiva conjunta, tolerante a falhas). The one problem is entry [11]. It renders "early fault-tolerant" as "tolerante a falhas antecipada" / "alvos tolerantes a falhas antecipados". "Antecipada" reads as "brought forward" or "premature" rather than "early-stage", so the phrase is stiff and slightly unclear. A native editor would write "tolerância a falhas em estágio inicial" or "tolerância a falhas inicial".

examples.source: Improvements in early fault-tolerant transpilation - ... transpilation to early fault-tolerant targets
examples.translation: Melhorias na transpilação tolerante a falhas antecipada - ... transpilação em alvos tolerantes a falhas antecipados
examples.suggested: Melhorias na transpilação para tolerância a falhas em estágio inicial - ... transpilação para alvos de tolerância a falhas em estágio inicial
examples.why: 'Antecipada/antecipados' is a calque that suggests 'brought forward' rather than 'early-stage', and it wrongly makes the transpilation itself the thing that is fault-tolerant. The meaning can still be recovered, so this is minor, not misleading.

editor_note: Entry 6 is accurate and does not mislead: 'Bloco Unificado Primitivo (PUB)', 'cargas de trabalho vetorizadas' and 'primitiva Estimator' are correct and match the rest of the page. Two small edits: 'opções de runtime especificadas pela primitiva' says the primitive sets the options itself, but the user sets them for the primitive, so 'definidas para a primitiva' is better. The opening 'Então, após o job ser concluído' copies the English 'Then,' and reads stiffly. A plain 'Após a conclusão do job' reads more naturally.

examples.source: the runtime options specified from the primitive
examples.translation: das opções de runtime especificadas pela primitiva
examples.suggested: das opções de runtime definidas para a primitiva
examples.why: 'pela primitiva' makes the primitive the one choosing the options. The user sets them on the primitive. The shift is small, but 'para a' is accurate.

examples.source: Then, after the job has completed, the results are returned
examples.translation: Então, após o job ser concluído, os resultados são retornados
examples.suggested: Após a conclusão do job, os resultados são retornados
examples.why: The 'Então,' opener copies the English 'Then,' and is stiff in Portuguese technical prose.

editor_note: None of the 18 rewritten entries changes the meaning. The precedence rules in [25] ("têm precedência sobre qualquer valor especificado como opção"), the twirling condition in [32] and the failure caveat in [36] ("o job falha se `twirling` estiver habilitado e o produto ... for menor que os shots necessários") all match the English, and the terms are consistent (primitiva, shots, job, argumento nomeado). The one change I'd make is to the link label used in 12 entries ([48], [53], [56], [71], [81], [90], [97], [105], [114], [131], [134], [146]). "Documentação de API `x`" copies the English word order and leaves out the article. A Portuguese technical writer would write "Documentação da API de `x`", or "Documentação da API: `x`".

examples.source: [`default_shots` API documentation](...)
examples.translation: [Documentação de API `default_shots`](...)
examples.suggested: [Documentação da API de `default_shots`](...)
examples.why: This copies the English word order and leaves out the article. "da API de" reads naturally in Portuguese. The same pattern repeats in all 12 API-documentation link labels.

editor_note: All four rewritten entries (4, 5, 6, 27) keep the English meaning, including the "largely" hedge in entry 6 ("em grande parte, substitutas diretas"), so nothing here would mislead a learner. Entry 6 copies the English gerund structure in "com a única mudança sendo a instrução de importação", and a native Brazilian editor would recast it. In entry 5, "pré e pós-processamento" drops the hyphen on the prefix and should be "pré- e pós-processamento". Entry 4's "ZNE de dobragem de gate" is recognizable, but "dobragem" leans European; Brazilian technical usage prefers "dobramento". That one is optional and not counted as an issue.

examples.source: with the only change being the import statement
examples.translation: com a única mudança sendo a instrução de importação
examples.suggested: bastando alterar apenas a instrução de importação
examples.why: The Portuguese copies the English 'with X being Y' gerund structure. A native technical writer would restructure the clause.

examples.source: most of the pre- and post-processing
examples.translation: a maior parte do pré e pós-processamento
examples.suggested: a maior parte do pré- e pós-processamento
examples.why: A prefix left hanging in a coordinated pair keeps its hyphen in Portuguese, so it should be 'pré-'.

editor_note: Entry 60 keeps the English meaning. Dynamical decoupling is rendered as "desacoplamento dinâmico", and both the claim that higher levels give more accurate results and the caveat about longer processing time are intact. One sentence has a grammar error and reads like a calque: "O nível de resiliência especifica quanto resiliência construir contra erros" needs "quanta", which agrees with the feminine "resiliência", and "construir resiliência contra erros" is a word-for-word copy of "build resilience against errors". A native editor would rephrase it to something like "define o grau de resiliência a erros a ser aplicado".

examples.source: The resilience level specifies how much resilience to build against errors.
examples.translation: O nível de resiliência especifica quanto resiliência construir contra erros.
examples.suggested: O nível de resiliência define o grau de resiliência a erros a ser aplicado.
examples.why: The gender agreement is wrong: it should be "quanta" to agree with "resiliência". "Construir resiliência contra erros" is a stiff word-for-word copy of the English that a Portuguese technical writer would not use. The meaning is still correct.

editor_note: All three rewritten entries are faithful and read naturally. Entry 24's disclaimer keeps its hedges ("pode depender", "Em alguns casos ... podem atingir uma qualidade final de solução semelhante após um pós-processamento equivalente"). Entry 8 ("versões ou mais recentes") and entry 63 ("Agora temos suporte para `ibm_miami`") also match the English exactly.

Nothing here would mislead a learner. The numbers, the order of the three configurations (26/60/70 qubits), the "lower is better" notes and the caveats all match the English. The problems are consistency and polish. "Raw" is translated as "circuito bruto" in [9] and [16] but left as "raw" in [25], [26], [28] and [45]. "Mid-circuit measurements" is "medições mid-circuit" in [12] but "medições no meio do circuito" in [19], [26] and [61]. MEM is masculine in [6], [7] and [12] ("o MEM") but feminine in [45] and [46] ("a MEM"). "The function" becomes the English "A function" in [13], while [36] uses "função". [25] also has an agreement slip ("circuitos … que alcançou" should be "alcançaram"), and "seamlessly" is rendered as a calque with "perfeitamente" ([8], [11]).

examples.source: (i), raw circuits without Orbit, which reached 26 qubits
examples.translation: (i) circuitos raw sem Orbit, que alcançou 26 qubits
examples.suggested: (i) circuitos brutos, sem o Orbit, que alcançaram 26 qubits
examples.why: The verb does not agree with its plural subject (the same error appears in all three items). It also uses 'raw', while [9] and [16] say 'bruto'.

examples.source: quantum error-correction circuits with mid-circuit measurements
examples.translation: circuitos de correção de erros quânticos com medições mid-circuit
examples.suggested: circuitos de correção de erros quânticos com medições no meio do circuito
examples.why: [19], [26] and [61] translate the same term as 'medições no meio do circuito'.

examples.source: which skips Orbit optimization, DD, and MEM
examples.translation: que ignora a otimização do Orbit, o DD e a MEM
examples.suggested: que ignora a otimização do Orbit, o DD e o MEM
examples.why: MEM is masculine ('o MEM') in [6], [7] and [12] but feminine here and in [46]. Pick one gender.

examples.source: The function is designed to introduce low overhead
examples.translation: A function foi projetada para introduzir baixo overhead
examples.suggested: A função foi projetada para introduzir pouco overhead
examples.why: This is a common noun, not the product name 'Qiskit Function', and [36] already says 'função'.

examples.source: users can seamlessly apply high-order, robust DD sequences
examples.translation: os usuários podem aplicar perfeitamente sequências de DD robustas e de alta ordem
examples.suggested: os usuários podem aplicar de forma transparente sequências de DD robustas e de alta ordem
examples.why: 'Aplicar perfeitamente' reads as 'apply flawlessly', not 'apply without friction'. 'De forma transparente' or 'sem esforço' is the natural phrasing.

editor_note: Entry [35] renders "quantum-centric supercomputing" as "computação quântica centrada em supercomputadores", which reverses IBM's concept. The English means supercomputing built around quantum processors, but the Portuguese says quantum computing built around supercomputers, so a learner would come away with the wrong idea of the paradigm. The rest is faithful, with smaller issues: [18] calques "tracked against" as "rastreados em relação ao job pai", [14] leaves "salva" without its object, and [25] "Isso inclui algumas limitações" is stiff.

examples.source: researchers used Qiskit Serverless and quantum-centric supercomputing
examples.translation: pesquisadores usaram o Qiskit Serverless e computação quântica centrada em supercomputadores
examples.suggested: pesquisadores usaram o Qiskit Serverless e supercomputação centrada em computação quântica
examples.why: This reverses the head noun and the modifier. The Portuguese describes quantum computing centered on supercomputers, not supercomputing centered on quantum, so it teaches the wrong concept.

examples.source: are tracked against the parent Qiskit Serverless job
examples.translation: sejam rastreados em relação ao job pai do Qiskit Serverless
examples.suggested: sejam associados ao job pai do Qiskit Serverless
examples.why: 'Rastreados em relação a' is a word-for-word calque of 'tracked against'. A native writer would say 'associados a' or 'contabilizados no'.

examples.source: Executing cells with this magic command saves them to disk rather than executing them.
examples.translation: A execução de células com esse comando mágico salva no disco em vez de executá-las.
examples.suggested: Executar células com esse comando mágico as salva no disco em vez de executá-las.
examples.why: The verb 'salva' has no object, so the sentence reads as incomplete.

examples.source: This includes several limitations:
examples.translation: Isso inclui algumas limitações:
examples.suggested: Há, porém, algumas limitações:
examples.why: This copies the English sentence structure and reads stiffly in Portuguese.

editor_note: Entries 47 and 48 keep their meaning. The negation "not every closed loop is contained in the stabilizer", the even-parity condition and the shrink-to-identity claim all come through intact. One small wording problem remains in entry 47: "não é verdade que todo laço ... está incluído no estabilizador" uses the indicative where native Portuguese wants the subjunctive "esteja". It also switches to "incluído", while the rest of the page, including entry 48, uses "contido" for "contained". In entry 48, "geradores do estabilizador $X$" matches the convention used across the file, and dropping the hedge "say" loses nothing.

examples.source: it is not the case that every closed loop of $X$ errors is contained in the stabilizer
examples.translation: não é verdade que todo laço fechado de erros $X$ está incluído no estabilizador
examples.suggested: não é verdade que todo laço fechado de erros $X$ esteja contido no estabilizador
examples.why: 'Não é verdade que' calls for the subjunctive. The file renders 'contained in the stabilizer' as 'contido' everywhere else (entries 48, 49, 52, 53), so 'incluído' breaks that consistency.

editor_note: The meaning is faithful throughout and nothing would mislead a learner. Course titles, "algoritmos quânticos de consulta", "busca não estruturada" and "fatoração de inteiros" are rendered correctly, and "você" is used consistently. Two small polish points remain. Headings copy English title case ("Visão Geral", "Badge Conquistado"), where Portuguese normally uses sentence case. "Após você passar no exame, receberá" in [12] is a stiff calque of "After you pass".

examples.source: Overview
examples.translation: Visão Geral
examples.suggested: Visão geral
examples.why: Portuguese headings use sentence case. Capitalizing every word copies English title case (the same applies to 'Badge Conquistado' -> 'Badge conquistado' in [14]).

examples.source: After you pass the exam, you will be notified by Credly that you have earned a badge.
examples.translation: Após você passar no exame, receberá uma notificação da Credly informando que conquistou um badge.
examples.suggested: Depois de passar no exame, você receberá uma notificação da Credly informando que conquistou um badge.
examples.why: 'Após você passar' follows the English clause order. The infinitive construction with the subject in the main clause reads more natively.

editor_note: The translation is faithful and reads naturally, and it uses the standard terms consistently: medições projetivas, medições na base padrão, discriminação/tomografia de estados quânticos and matriz densidade. The caveat "geralmente alterando ou destruindo-o" is kept.

Faithful and native across all four entries: "Simulação clássica", "Aula 08", "O módulo está hospedado no GitHub" and "pode ser considerada opcional, mas é altamente recomendada" each match the English exactly.
